ownership_and_relationships.sbi_exact_cash_or_xrp_subscription_alloc: Not disclosed in the cited prospectus; do not infer 39.9% of cash raised or XRP contributed.
ownership_and_relationships.coinbase_principal_market_designation: Evernorth selected Coinbase as the principal market for XRP for financial-reporting purposes. This does not establish exclusivity as execution venue, custodian or trading counterparty.

cftc_letter_26_05.type: conditional staff no-action position, not a generally applicable rule or automatic asset approval

relevant_conditions.dco_acceptance: For futures customer and cleared-swaps customer collateral, the digital asset must be accepted by a registered DCO and valuation/haircuts follow that DCO.
relevant_conditions.thirty_seven_customer_path: For 30.7 customer accounts, the letter includes a non-security digital asset that is the underlying commodity of a futures contract listed on a CFTC-registered DCM, subject to the letter's conditions.
relevant_conditions.no_dco_or_qualifying_foreign_clearing_ac: At least a 20% haircut applies to non-security digital assets other than payment stablecoins, subject to the narrow same-asset contract exception.
relevant_conditions.non_btc_eth_stablecoin_policy: Before accepting other non-security digital assets, the FCM must file revised risk-management policies with MPD.
relevant_conditions.notice: FCM must file notice of intent and intended commencement date before relying on the no-action position.
relevant_conditions.narrow_same_asset_exception: The exception applies only to a customer position in a contract both based on and denominated in that digital asset, and only to the extent collateral offsets a deficit in that same cleared contract.

cftc_letter_26_05.xrp_status: No XRP-specific FCM notice, actual XRP customer-margin posting or CME DCO acceptance was verified. CME XRP futures are USD cash-settled, so do not assume the same-asset-denominated exception applies.

corrections: The $214.05M cash-funded XRP purchase is not an additional capital raise.
The $10.5M delayed cash subscription is distinct from the advance funding.
The $388.910554M XRP in-kind total includes the disclosed advance, delayed, Series C, contributor-related-party and Ripple contribution components.
The $30M PIK note is debt; the filing's later financial-statement note reports approximately $29M net cash after a $1M advisor fee.
The $80M-style ELOC headline is conditional capacity; the filing says zero proceeds had been received as of November 9.
SBI's 39.9% post-close voting power is not evidence that SBI supplied 39.9% of the cash or XRP.
model_eligibility: Research-only. This filing is not a market feature and must be admitted through a separately timestamped raw-source receipt before use in the point-in-time feature store.
